narrativeSynthesis.description: Claimant parked vehicle in office parking lot

anomalySignals.description: Witness states incident occurred at 10:30 AM, but claimant was in office from 9:15-11:15 AM
anomalySignals.explanation: The witness timeline places the incident 45 minutes before the claimant discovered the damage. This is consistent with a hit-and-run scenario, but the 2-hour window creates uncertainty about when damage actually occurred.

anomalySignals.description: Damage pattern suggests forward-moving collision, but witness describes backing vehicle
anomalySignals.explanation: The damage to the driver's side door and fender shows impact characteristics consistent with a forward-moving vehicle, not a backing collision. This conflicts with the witness description of an SUV backing out.

anomalySignals.description: No parking lot surveillance footage available
anomalySignals.explanation: The parking lot does not have security cameras. This limits our ability to verify the witness account or identify the at-fault vehicle.

evidenceItems.description: Hit-and-run report filed within required timeframe
Written statement from Jane Wilson describing white SUV
Professional assessment of damage pattern and estimated repair cost

recommendedAction.description: Request claimant to provide office building entry/exit records to verify timeline, and seek additional witnesses
recommendedAction.rationale: While coverage applies for hit-and-run under uninsured motorist provisions, the timeline and damage pattern inconsistencies require resolution before proceeding. Additional evidence could clarify the incident sequence.
recommendedAction.estimatedImpact: Processing delayed 3-5 business days pending additional evidence. Estimated settlement $3,200-$4,500 if evidence supports claim.
recommendedAction.claimantMessage: We are reviewing your claim and need some additional information to proceed. Please provide any records showing when you entered and exited the office building, and let us know if there are any other witnesses we should contact.
